mapper.select: SELECT h.id, h.name, h.detail, h.cover, h.covers, h.area_id, h.community_id, h.sized_id, h.type_id, h.size_number, h.direction_id, h.fitment_status_id, h.rent, h.deposit_method_id, h.is_subway, h.floor, h.subway_line, h.living_facilities, h.rental_type, h.status, h.rental_humen, h.contract, h.create_time, ho.create_time AS order_time, c.name AS community_name, a.parent_id AS top_area_id, a.name AS city_area_name, l.id AS landlord_id, l.idcard AS landlord_idcard, u.username AS landlord_name, u.avatar AS landlord_avatar, u.phone AS landlord_phone, ou.username AS order_user_name, ou.avatar AS order_user_avatar, ou.phone AS order_user_phone FROM house h LEFT JOIN community c ON c.id = h.community_id LEFT JOIN area a ON a.id = h.area_id LEFT JOIN landlord l ON l.id = h.landlord_id LEFT JOIN user u ON u.id = l.user_id LEFT JOIN house_order_info ho ON ho.house_id = h.id LEFT JOIN user ou ON ou.id = ho.user_id WHERE h.id = #{id}
SELECT h.id, h.create_time FROM house h WHERE h.create_time BETWEEN #{startTime} AND #{endTime}
SELECT a.name, COUNT(h.id) AS count FROM house h LEFT JOIN area a ON a.id = h.area_id GROUP BY a.name LIMIT #{limitCount}
